set.body: Parent epic: bd-01KR8ZJJ8W882F1S9JWE06K741. Add graph_heat backend over mask voxels using sparse adjacency/Laplacian construction. Borrow/adapt from ~/code/adjoin for spatial_adjacency(), graph_weights_fast(), laplacian, normalization, and isolate handling. Do not use dense diffusion kernels for whole-brain scans. Tests: tiny graphs match dense expm, isolate handling, backend agreement with grid Gaussian on simple regular cases where appropriate.
